<!-- R1 — abstract: establishes that the diagnostics report numbers -->
<!-- slot: abstract -->

We report five numbers over the drafted prose — not one of them is a verdict.

<!-- slot: introduction -->

Registration drift is unaddressed.

The existing tooling reports a number.

However, a number that is read as a target is a number that will be tuned, and tuning it is
cheaper than doing the work the number stood for. That is the whole reason the ratio below
carries no threshold, and the reason the sentence-length figures carry none either.

<!-- slot: results -->

Accuracy is sufficient for per-arm comparison — the drift left that open, whereas the earlier
pipeline left it unmeasured.

The measurement holds across every arm of the cohort, and it holds across the two acquisition
rounds that were repeated after the stage-two failure, which together cover enough of the run
to say that the accuracy reported here is the accuracy a reader would obtain — a claim the
table below records stage by stage.

| stage | note |
|---|---|
| registration | pairwise — against the shared channel |
